Interview Experience
Mohit Bhoir
B.Tech Comp 2025
Criteria - Minimum 7 CPI
Online assessment
8th November
There were two coding questions with 45 min of time.
Question 1:
You have given a string where you need to find out the frequency of characters other
than English alphabets ( case insensitive) , numbers(0-9) and whitespaces.
Input :- “ab &11*cd”
Output :- 2
( ‘&’ and ‘*’ )
Can be easily solved using conditional statements or using hashmap.
Question 2:
An employee in an organization has started working on N project(numbered 1 to N)
every week he can work on a module of one of the proejct . the modules that are
chosen on any two successive weeks should be of a different project and a project i
can have at most Ci modules. the modules of the projects are such that a module is
completed in a week.
write a algo to determine the number of weeks for which he/she can work on projects
following the above-mentioned rules

Input :-
3
7 2 3
output:
11
Here is the solution for the question
https://leetcode.com/discuss/interview-question/1238078/number-of-weeks-for-whi
ch-heshe-can-work-on-projects
Overall both questions were easy so i was able to solve them within 20 min.
Interviews
21st November
A total 20 students were shortlisted.
There were 3 rounds for the interview ( 2 technical + 1 hr) all scheduled on the same
day.All interviews were held on MS teams.
Tech round 1
12:00 pm
Students were divided into 4 panels with 5 students in each panel.There were two
interviewers during my round but one had kept its cam and mick off for the whole
interview.
1. My interview didn’t start with any intro from either side and he directly jumped into
the projects which I had mentioned in my resume.
Questions were :-
1) How you implemented the payment option ( stripe and its implementation)
2) How you implemented JWT authentication
He was interested in more technical answers ( like what api routes you used , then
tokens , middleware , etc.) so I answered him accordingly and he seemed satisfied.
2. He asked me a coding question and told me to write the code for it using any
editor of my choice ( of course I used VS code ).The question was to find the
frequency of digits in number. Although the question was easy it involved a lot of
edge cases so he asked me about them as well.Make sure to ask for all the

constraints,input types to the interviewer and also explain the logic behind each
statement while writing the code.
3. Types of Operating systems.
4. Difference between Main and secondary memory.One thing to note here is that he
didn’t have a set number of questions so whatever answer I had given him based on
that he asked me the next questions like in this case difference between the two
memories.
5. Then he asked me to write some Basic SQL query again this question was based
on my resume since I had mentioned MySQL in my skills.
6. Types of Network topologies.Make sure to answer the questions thoroughly like in
this case for the types of topologies also explain them a bit with their names.
7. Difference between stack and queue.
Finally,he asked me if I had any questions.You can expect this question after most of
the interviews so always keep 1-2 questions ready with you.
Tech round 2
1:30 pm
I was interviewed by a single interviewer in this round.Initially he specified that we
have only 30 mins so be precise with your answers.
1. This time the interview started with an introduction of him and then I introduced
myself.Although in my first round interviewer didn’t ask me to introduce myself but
this is also the most common question that you can find in any interview.So be ready
with a 1-2 min intro.
2. Then he asked me about the different software development life cycles and the
difference between the waterfall and agile model.
3. He then asked me about wild pointers in CPP.Since I didn’t have much
programming experience in CPP I told him to ask questions in JAVA.It is really
important to understand your strengths during the interview and it is ok to say no to
things you don’t know,they won’t judge you based on that.
4. Then he asked me why array index in java starts from 0.For this i didn’t know the
exact answer but I gave him some logical answer and he seemed satisfied.
5.Then he asked me to write down the recursive code for the Fibonacci series and
then told me to explain it.

6. After 20 mins or so,he began to ask HR questions, I was not expecting this
because in all of the previous tech 2 rounds focus was more on technical stuff.
7. The questions were standard HR questions like whether you consider yourself an
extrovert or an introvert and why, your biggest achievements , daily routine , etc.
It was more of a friendly discussion.At last,he also gave me feedback about the
entire interview,how I performed.
At this point , I was a bit nervous coz of the feedback he gave to me.But after my
tech 2 round within 10 mins , I was called for the HR round.
●
Also in this round,He asked me about two major questions, one was why you want to
join sap and the second was the full form of SAP ( Remember S-A-P hota hai SAP
nahi ) , in which I fumbled a bit.So make sure to research thoroughly about the
company you are applying for.
HR Round
2:55 pm
Although this round lasted only for 5 mins for me this was not the case for others.Also
usually HR rounds for SAP labs are quite chill and they select almost everyone after
HR round for the internship but this time the HR rounds were almost 15 mins long or
even more for some students ( I think this was based on the feedback we had
received from the previous rounds , all interviewers had those feedbacks with them).
1. The HR was very friendly, she asked me to introduce myself and then asked me the
standard question again why do you want to join SAP.
2. She also asked me about the location preferences and whether I would be
comfortable with locations outside Mumbai.
As I said, it lasted only for 5 min.She finally asked if I had any questions again, I
asked her 2 questions and the interview ended.
The results came at around 12:00 am , it was a long wait for me tbh.
Total of 7 students were shortlisted for the internship.
Trust the timing of everything.Just because it’s not happening right now doesn’t
mean it never will . ( Google se hi liya hai but I am sure you can relate with it 😉)
All the best !!
